# gitea_org_webhooks (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all webhooks for an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_org_webhooks" "example" {
  org = "my-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org` (String) Organization name

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `webhooks` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
